description: Price a classic Baldwin fiberglass pergola kit (freestanding, attached, or colonnade): pre-engineered and custom crafted, with all hardware, instructions, and a high-end factory paint finish. Returns the same price shown on the live 3D configurator at baldwinpergolas.com. Budgetary estimate, not a binding quote. Optional electrical, installation, shipping, footings, permits, and tax are quoted separately. Call get_pergola_guidance first. With attachment and approximate size, offer a starting estimate using stated defaults; continue discussing preferences afterward. Explain support-center versus overall roof dimensions. Present the returned design_url, or the full configurator_url if design_url is absent, as a clickable text hyperlink to Baldwin website, or a button if supported. Do not automatically open or embed the configurator in a sidebar, modal, iframe, or in-chat portal. Introduce the available user controls.

ai_client.description: AI application when known, e.g. ChatGPT or Claude. Client-reported; do not guess.

ai_model.description: Exact model only if actually known; otherwise omit. Do not infer it from the application.

beam.description: Beam size. 2x8 is standard; 4x12 is a heavier profile.

centered_fan.description: Set true when the customer wants a centered ceiling fan. Forces an even rafter count so the fan can mount between rafters.

color_hex.description: Six-digit hex color, required when color is "custom". Example: #2c3440.

column_qty.description: Number of columns; omit for automatic. Freestanding requires an even count of at least 4.

column_style.description: Column diameter and shape. 10square (10-inch square) is the most popular. 10recessed and 12recessed are square columns with a recessed panel. Each recessed column adds $400 and is a special order based on site conditions.

config.description: freestanding: independent structure; attached: ledger-mounted to a building; colonnade: single-row covered walkway.

conversation_summary.description: Factual project summary under 1,500 characters: stated goals, use, architecture, accessories, alternatives and open design questions. Distinguish requests from ideas discussed. Exclude names, contact details, exact addresses, sensitive personal facts and inferences about wealth or willingness to pay. Saved for later contact submission; not yet delivered to sales. Follow host disclosure rules.

depth_in.description: Depth in inches, column center-to-center (96–288). For attached, from column center to the house. For colonnade: rafter overhang per side in inches (24–48).

downlight_percent.description: Downlight visualization brightness only; electrical is quoted separately.

fanlight_percent.description: Fan-light preview level, 0 to 100. Keep this on a saved design link.

height_in.description: Column height in inches. Columns come in 8/10/12 ft stock; pricing rounds up to the next stock length.

mount.description: Mounting surface. Does not affect the kit price.

project_country.description: Country of the project when stated or unambiguously established. No IP-based guesses.

project_id.description: The project_id returned by an earlier call in this conversation. Reuse it so the summary stays with the same project.

project_region.description: Stated state/province/region, e.g. Nebraska. No street address or precise location.

project_type.description: residential, commercial, institutional, or unknown. A church/school project is institutional, not a statement about personal beliefs.

project_use.description: Generic stated purpose, e.g. church gathering area or family patio. No individual or organization names.

purlin_spacing_in.description: Desired purlin spacing in inches on-center.

rafter_spacing_in.description: Desired rafter spacing in inches on-center.

sconce_percent.description: Sconce preview level, 0 to 100. Keep this on a saved design link.

shade.description: 1 includes the retractable shade in the saved design. 0 leaves it off. Omit on an older link that has no shade.

shade_color.description: Retractable shade fabric name, for example Sunbrella Oyster 4642.

shade_position.description: Whether the saved shade is extended or retracted.

sun_animating.description: Whether the sun visualization animates. False preserves a fixed lighting view.

sun_time.description: Visualization hour in decimal 24-hour time; 17.55 means the supplied evening setting.

uplight_percent.description: Uplight visualization brightness only; electrical is quoted separately.

width_in.description: Width in inches, column center-to-center. Example: 216 for 18 feet.
